title: Cascade leaves higher zones unchanged
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number, let $j$ be a natural number, and let $z$ be zone contents with $\ell$ levels. For any level $k<\ell$ with $j<k$, the rightward cascade through $j$ levels leaves both the left and right words at level $k$ unchanged.
